categories.question: Which cosmic object would you put on an observatory poster?

outcomes.name: Sombrero Galaxy
outcomes.description: Edge-on pale galactic disk with bulging centre and sharp dark dust lane

outcomes.name: Ring Nebula
outcomes.description: Oval blue-centred planetary nebula with a red-orange ring, isolated on alpha

outcomes.name: Pleiades
outcomes.description: Compact jewel-like cluster of seven bright blue-white stars in delicate blue reflection mist

outcomes.name: Crab Nebula
outcomes.description: Oval orange filaments of a supernova remnant surrounding a blue-green centre
